corePackage.description: Framework-neutral modular TypeScript file preview core with format registry, renderer orchestration, lifecycle APIs, search, zoom, print, and export.
corePackage.note: Core source is public. The private Gitea repository remains the complete aggregate workspace with release automation, integration history, and priority support for sponsors.

wrapperRepositories.description: Framework-free modular File Viewer package with Custom Element, ESM APIs, script-tag IIFE, and RequireJS AMD entry.
Full Vanilla JS and Web Component package with frozen standard profile enabled by default for CDN, script-tag, Custom Element, and imperative mounting.
Production-ready Vue 3 file viewer component powered by @file-viewer/core, with toolbar, search, zoom, watermark, print, and export support.
Full Vue 3 component package with frozen standard profile enabled by default for one-component, one-line complete preview integration.
Production-ready Vue 2.7 file viewer component powered by @file-viewer/core for teams maintaining modern Vue 2 applications.
Full Vue 2.7 component package with frozen standard profile enabled by default for common-format preview coverage in modern Vue 2 projects.
Production-ready Vue 2.6 file viewer component powered by @file-viewer/core for legacy Vue applications.
Full Vue 2.6 component package with frozen standard profile enabled by default for legacy Vue applications that need the frozen common-format matrix.
Production-ready React file viewer component powered by @file-viewer/core, with hooks, document actions, search, zoom, print, and export.
Full React component package with frozen standard profile enabled by default while preserving the standard React handle and hook experience.
Production-ready React 16.8/17 file viewer component powered by @file-viewer/core for long-lived React applications.
Full React 16.8/17 component package with frozen standard profile enabled by default for long-lived React applications.
jQuery file viewer plugin powered by @file-viewer/core for legacy and mixed frontend stacks.
Full jQuery plugin package with frozen standard profile enabled by default for legacy and mixed frontend stacks.
Production-ready Svelte file viewer component powered by @file-viewer/core with the same viewer options and document actions.
Full Svelte component and action package with frozen standard profile enabled by default and the same viewer actions as the standard package.
